# CineTrack Technical Specification & AI Knowledge Base

## Overview
CineTrack is a full-stack Next.js 16 application engineered for movie tracking and catalog management.

## Application Architecture
- **Framework**: Next.js 16 (App Router, Turbopack)
- **Language**: TypeScript
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS with dark slate theme, custom glassmorphism, and responsive design
- **Database / Auth**: Supabase (PostgreSQL, Row Level Security, Auth) with localStorage fallback
- **Movie Data API**: The Movie Database (TMDB) API (v3)

## Complete Route Documentation

### 1. Discover (`/`)
- **Hero Spotlight**: 6-second auto-advancing carousel showcasing top 5 trending movies.
- **Category Rows**: 10-item previews for Trending, Popular, Comedy, Romance, Action, Sci-Fi.
- **Section Headers**: Direct "View More" navigation to dedicated genre routes.

### 2. Search Engine (`/search`)
- **Query Search**: Debounced real-time TMDB search.
- **Genre Filters**: Filter pills for Action (28), Comedy (35), Romance (10749), Sci-Fi (878), Horror (27), Drama (18), Animation (16).
- **Sort Options**: Popularity, Highest Rated, Newest Release.
- **Infinite Scroll**: Auto-paginating IntersectionObserver infinite scroll.

### 3. Personal Library (`/library`)
- **Watch Status Tabs**: Watched, Plan to Watch, Watching, All Saved.
- **Stats Overview**: Total watched count, watch time in hours, mean rating, plan to watch count.
- **Library Search & Filters**: Title search, Star rating filters (9+, 7+, 5+, Unrated), and sorting (Recently Updated, Rating, Title).

### 4. Custom Collections (`/collections` and `/collections/[id]`)
- Create, rename, delete custom movie lists.
- Add movies directly from detail modals.
- Real-time search and sorting.

### 5. Genre Catalogs (`/genre/[id]`)
- Infinite scroll paginated catalog for any TMDB genre or category ID.
